of each equal sub-interval; `end` defaults to the asset's end), in a grid of `columns` (default

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

get.description:
The asset's picture at `time` seconds as a JPEG (default) or PNG, optionally scaled (never up) to
`width` and/or `height`, keeping the aspect ratio. `source=auto` reads the proxy when there is one (small
and within 1/15 s of `time`); `source=original` reads the file itself.

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

get.description:
The stored on-screen text that was up at some point between `start` and `end` seconds (the whole
recording by default), one page of `limit` states (default 20, at most 200) with a `next_cursor` to pass back
until it is null. Each item is `{time, until, text, lines, source_scene}`. 404 until an ocr job has run, or
after the file changed; 422 for a bad span, limit or cursor.

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

post.description:
Queue reading the text on the asset's screen: a frame at each scene change (when scenes exist) and every
`interval` seconds, read from the original with Tesseract. The job's result is `{asset, engine, duration,
interval, max_frames, scenes_used, frames, scene_frames, ocr_frames, skipped_unchanged, capped,
frames_before_cap, failed_frames, note, made}`; read the text with `GET /assets/{id}/ocr` and search it with
`GET /assets/{id}/ocr/search`. 501 (detail: the install hint) without the tesseract program; 422 for an
audio-only asset.

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

get.description:
Where the text `q` was on screen: fuzzy and token-based (case-insensitive, split on anything that is not a
letter or digit, so `test_cut_burst` finds `test cut burst`; every token must be in the same frame). Hits best
first with `source` ("ocr"), `time`, `end`, `score` (0..1), `text` (the best line), `context_before` /
`context_after` (`context` lines each, default 1, at most 10) and `matched_tokens`; `limit` per page (default
20, at most 200) and a `next_cursor`. `start` / `end` keep text that was up in that span. 404 without stored
text; 422 for an empty or over-long query (500 characters), a bad span, limit or cursor.

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

get.description:
The proxy video (H.264 MP4, Range requests answered with 206). 404 until the proxy job has run, and
for ever for an audio-only asset (the message says so).

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

post.description:
Queue making the asset's proxy and thumbnail strip (whichever is missing; both with `force`). The job's
result is `{asset, proxy, thumbnails, made}`. An audio-only asset has neither: 422 (the CLI and
MCP report it as `skipped` instead).

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

get.description:
The stored signals, or with `start` and/or `end` (seconds) only the cuts in that span and the activity
values overlapping it (`activity_start` says which second the first one covers). 404 until a
scene_analysis job has run, or after the file changed.

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

post.description:
Queue finding the asset's scene changes and screen-activity curve, from its proxy if it has a current one
(else the original). The job's result is `{asset, source, duration, threshold, min_gap, scenes,
activity_buckets, made}`; read the signals with `GET /assets/{id}/scenes`. 422 for an audio-only asset.

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

get.description:
Find where `q` was said or shown, in the transcript and the on-screen text together. Hits are moments,
best first: `source`, `time` (seconds, where to seek), `end`, `score` (0..1, comparable across sources:
phrase in one source about 0.9 to 1.0, said AND shown higher, one word of a longer query about half),
`text`, `context_before` / `context_after` (`context` words or lines, at most 10), `found_in`, `match` and
`evidence` (each source's own hit). Things said and shown within 15 s are one moment. `sources` (comma
separated: transcript, ocr; default both) limits the search; the `sources` in the answer says what was
searched and how to make what is missing. `start` / `end` keep hits in that span; `limit` per page (default
20, at most 200) and a `next_cursor` to pass back until it is null. 404 when none of the requested sources
has data; 422 for a bad query (500 characters at most), source, span, limit or cursor.

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

get.description:
Find where `q` was on the screen: the on-screen text search (as `GET /assets/{id}/ocr/search`: fuzzy,
token-based, best first, `source: "ocr"`, `score` 0..1, `time`, `end`, `text`, context lines) plus `sources`,
which visual sources were searched. 404 without stored on-screen text (run an ocr job); 422 for a bad
query, span, limit or cursor.

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

get.description:
The thumbnail strip: one JPEG sprite of evenly spaced frames (see `/thumbnails/info`). 404 until the
proxy job has run, and for an audio-only asset (the message says so).

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

get.description:
The sprite's layout: tile size, columns, rows, tile count and seconds per tile (and `tolerance`, how
far a tile's frame may be from its nominal time). 404 as `GET .../thumbnails`.

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

post.description:
Queue transcribing the asset's audio with word timestamps. The job's result is `{asset, model, language,
duration, segments, words, made}`; read the words with `GET /assets/{id}/transcript`. 501 (detail: the
install hint) when the optional faster-whisper package is not installed; 422 for an asset with no audio.

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

get.description:
The stored transcript, or with `start` and/or `end` (seconds) only the words overlapping that span. With
any of `limit`, `cursor`, `granularity` (`segment` or `word`) or `max_chars` it is one page of the segments
(or words) overlapping the span instead, with `total_in_range` and a `next_cursor` to pass back until it is
null; a page never holds more than 500 items. 404 until a transcription job has run, or after the file
changed; 422 for a bad span, limit or cursor.

schema.title: Response Get Transcript Api V1 Assets  Asset Id  Transcript Get

401.description: No valid bearer token (only when the server is started with SPLIT_VIDEO_TOKEN).

get.description:
Where the phrase `q` is said: case-insensitive whole-word match, punctuation ignored, across segment
boundaries. Hits in time order with `time`, `end`, `text`, `context_before` / `context_after` (`context`
words each, default 8, at most 50), `segment` and `word` indices; `limit` per page (default 20, at most
200) and a `next_cursor`. `start` / `end` keep hits whose first word overlaps that span. 404 without a
transcript; 422 for an empty or over-long query (500 characters), a bad span, limit or cursor.

get.description: A `text/event-stream` of job progress and project changes; keep it open instead of polling. Frames: `event: hello` first (server `time`, `resync`, `resumed`, `last_event_id`, and the `jobs` queued or running now); `event: job` with `{type: submitted|progress|state, job: <the JobOut of GET /jobs/{id}>, previous?: <state>}`; `event: project` with `{kind: split|timeline, project_id, revision, source: local|external}` (`local`: written through this server; `external`: another process, e.g. the CLI or MCP server, changed the project and the server noticed within about a second); `: keepalive` comment lines when quiet; `event: overflow` (the client fell behind, reconnect) and `event: shutdown` (the server is stopping) end the stream. Every `job` and `project` frame has an increasing `id:`; a reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` replays what it missed from the last 500 events, or gets `hello` with `resync: true` (refetch state) if that is no longer possible. `progress` is throttled to about 10 per second per job and the final progress always precedes the job's `state` event. `kind` (`job`, `project`; repeatable or comma-separated), `job` and `project` filter the stream; `hello`, `overflow` and `shutdown` are always sent. The polling endpoints stay available.
